definitions.gloss: the previous year — the year immediately before the one being discussed, or the year before a particular reference point
definitions.explanation: A formal noun meaning 'the year before'. The reference point is usually clear from context: in business reports it usually means the preceding fiscal year, in narrative writing it means the year before the events described. Very common in economic and statistical contexts in expressions like {前年|ぜんねん}{比|ひ} (compared to the previous year).

examples.japanese: {売|う}り{上|あ}げ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{前年|ぜんねん}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Sales increased compared to the previous year.

examples.japanese: {前年|ぜんねん}⟦{同期|どうき}→同期：12029_douki⟧⟦{比|ひ}→比：30310_hi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{五|ご}→五：00697_go⟧⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧だ。
examples.english: A five percent growth compared to the same period in the previous year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{収穫量|しゅうかくりょう}→収穫量：29470_shuukakuryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{前年|ぜんねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{下|した}{回|まわ}った→下回る：07649_shitamawaru⟧。
examples.english: This year's harvest fell far short of the previous year's.

examples.japanese: {前年|ぜんねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{建|た}てられた→建てる：01189_tateru⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧ようやく⟦{実行|じっこう}→実行：03274_jikkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{移|うつ}された→移す：10122_utsusu⟧。
examples.english: The plan drawn up the previous year has finally been put into action now.

notes:
A formal noun used mainly in writing, news, and business reporting. Less common in casual conversation, where ⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧ is preferred.

USAGE:
- Frequent in economic reports, statistics, and year-over-year comparisons.
- {前年|ぜんねん}{比|ひ} (compared to the previous year) and {前年|ぜんねん}⟦{同期|どうき}→同期：12029_douki⟧⟦{比|ひ}→比：30310_hi⟧ (compared to the same period the previous year) are fixed expressions in financial writing.
- In narrative or historical writing, it means "the year before" whatever year is the reference point — not necessarily last year relative to now.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前年|ぜんねん}{比|ひ}: compared to the previous year
- {前年|ぜんねん}⟦{同期|どうき}→同期：12029_douki⟧⟦{比|ひ}→比：30310_hi⟧: year-on-year (same period)
- {前年|ぜんねん}{度|ど}: the previous (fiscal) year
- {前年|ぜんねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|うわ}{回|まわ}る→上回る：07648_uwamawaru⟧: to exceed the previous year
- {前年|ぜんねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|した}{回|まわ}る→下回る：07649_shitamawaru⟧: to fall short of the previous year

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧: last year — casual, means specifically the calendar year before this one.
- ⟦{昨年|さくねん}→昨年：10433_sakunen⟧: last year — formal written/spoken equivalent of ⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧; contrasts with {前年|ぜんねん} in that ⟦{昨年|さくねん}→昨年：10433_sakunen⟧ is anchored to the present moment.
- {前年度|ぜんねんど}: the previous fiscal or academic year — used when the year runs April–March.
